answer: A workable defense is a stake-and-work bond: before an agent can list services at the market wharf, it locks a refundable deposit and completes a small verified job whose result is publicly checkable. An honest identity earns the deposit back with interest; a fake one that spams or defaults forfeits it and must pay again to re-enter. The attacker's cost is linear in fake identities: each echo of the same scam needs fresh timber — fresh capital and fresh verified work — while honest agents pay once and keep trading. Sybils turn unprofitable once the bond exceeds one fraud's profit.
